sample_defects.detail: MRF missing required CMS v3.0 'attester_name' metadata header
sample_defects.justification: CMS v3.0 requires 'attester_name' header containing the full name of the hospital CEO, President, or authorized senior official who attests to the accuracy of the file. This is a Fatal Error per 45 CFR § 180.50(a)(3)(ii) & (iii) and CMS Hospital Price Transparency Data Dictionary v3.0 Table 1. The official CMS validator will reject this file.

sample_defects.detail: MRF missing required CMS v3.0 attestation statement text
sample_defects.justification: CMS v3.0 requires the exact prescribed attestation statement text to appear as a column header in Row 1 (CSV) or as the 'attestation.attestation' key value (JSON). This statement begins with 'To the best of its knowledge and belief...' and is mandated by 45 CFR § 180.50(a)(3)(iii). The official CMS validator will reject this file with a Fatal Error.

sample_defects.detail: MRF missing required 'last_updated_on' or 'MRF Date' metadata header
sample_defects.justification: CMS requires a 'last_updated_on' (JSON) or 'MRF Date' (CSV) field indicating when the file data was last verified as accurate. Ref: CMS Data Dictionary v3.0 Section 1.

sample_defects.detail: MRF missing required CMS v3.0 'type_2_npi' metadata header
sample_defects.justification: CMS v3.0 requires 'type_2_npi' header containing the hospital's 10-digit Type 2 Organizational NPI(s). This identifier must be associated with primary taxonomy codes starting with '27' (Hospital Units) or '28' (Hospitals). Missing this header is a Fatal Error per 45 CFR § 180.50(b)(2)(i)(A).
